supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 repeatedly connected to the internal proxy at approximately five-minute intervals during the alert window: observed sessions include 13:30:03, 13:36:22, 13:41:10, 13:46:34, 13:51:47, 13:55:57, 14:01:14, and 14:06:22 UTC. The intervals are approximate, not uniform.

The cited recurring sessions are recorded as TCP connections from WS-BCARTER-01 to 10.30.20.30:8080, the proxy; these records do not identify the external HTTPS destination or the originating workstation process.
At 14:10, OneDrive.exe was launched and Chrome made successful requests to SharePoint, but these records do not establish that either generated the earlier recurring connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: For the recurring sessions, the supplied records contain proxy-bound connection summaries but no matching proxy records identifying destination hostnames, URLs, or tunnel details.
The supplied records do not map the recurring connections to a process, executable, command line, or user action.
claims_not_established: Whether the recurring sessions reached an approved service, an unapproved service, or a malicious destination.
Whether the sessions were generated by the ChartMate updater or another legitimate scheduled application.
Whether the recurring activity was malicious; the cadence alone does not establish intent.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve proxy CONNECT and TLS inspection logs for the recurring session times, including destination hostnames, URLs where available, and tunnel identifiers.
Obtain endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 at the matching times, including process path, command line, signer, and hash.
Verify whether ChartMate was installed and running on WS-BCARTER-01 during the window, and compare its update-check logs and destination with the recurring sessions.
